scripts.check: vp check && vp run typecheck && fallow dead-code --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow dead-code --production --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow health --complexity --format compact
scripts.fix: vp check --fix; status=$?; vp fmt && vp run typecheck && fallow dead-code --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow dead-code --production --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow health --complexity --format compact && exit $status
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'TSRS_CHECKER_ASSIGNMENT=go tsrs --build . apps/*/tsconfig.json packages/*/tsconfig.json tools/*/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false --force'
